audience: email marketers who send newsletters and campaigns with Moosend

useCases.title: Check how a campaign did
useCases.text: The AI reads a sent campaign's results: sent, opens, clicks, bounces, complaints and unsubscribes. It compares campaigns from the list.

useCases.title: Find which links and countries got the most response
useCases.text: The AI lists every link in a campaign with total and unique clicks, and the opens by country code. You see what readers care about.

useCases.title: Count subscribers per list and find one by email
useCases.text: The AI lists mailing lists with active, bounced, removed and unsubscribed counts, and looks up a subscriber by email address in a list.

useCases.title: Read segments and who matches them
useCases.text: The AI lists the segments of a list with their criteria, and lists the subscribers who currently match one segment.

useCases.title: Create lists and add, update or unsubscribe subscribers
useCases.text: The AI adds a subscriber to a list or updates one, and unsubscribes an email from one list. It can also create a mailing list.
